outcome: An Aura, Equipment or Fortification is moved onto the new object or player unless it could not enchant, equip or fortify it, in which case it stays put.
An attach effect aimed at an illegal object or player, at the current host, or by a non-attachable object does nothing and nothing moves.
Re-attaching to a different object gives the attachment a new timestamp, changing its ordering against other continuous effects.
An attachment becomes unattached when it moves, leaves the battlefield, its host leaves the zone, or the player leaves, and 'becomes unattached' triggers fire.
